1. **Torque due to Gravity**:

   \[
   \tau_{\text{gravity}} = -mg l \sin\theta
   \]

   \tau_{\text{external}} = f(t) l \cos\theta
   \]

   \[
   \tau_{\text{total}} = f(t) l \cos\theta - mg l \sin\theta
   \]

\[
\boxed{3.06 \times 10^2 \, \text{pm}}
